amalekite-messenger.name: The Amalekite messenger
amalekite-messenger.role: Messenger who claims to have killed Saul
amalekite-messenger.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
amalekite-messenger.importance: His report differs from 1 Samuel 31. David orders his death.
amalekite-messenger.connections: Brings Saul’s crown and bracelet to David.

word.languageNote: This is the dictionary form of the name “Amalekite.”

ishbosheth.name: Ishbosheth
ishbosheth.role: Saul’s son installed as king by Abner
ishbosheth.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
ishbosheth.importance: Ishbosheth depends on Abner’s support. When Abner leaves him, his rule soon ends in murder.
ishbosheth.connections: Rival to David after Saul’s death.

joab.name: Joab
joab.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
joab.importance: He serves David as army commander. He also kills Abner, Absalom, and Amasa against David's wishes.
joab.connections: Son of Zeruiah. Brother of Abishai and Asahel.

asahel.name: Asahel
asahel.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
asahel.importance: Abner kills him after warnings. His death leads to another killing.
asahel.connections: Brother of Joab and Abishai. Son of Zeruiah.

rizpah.name: Rizpah
rizpah.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
rizpah.importance: She protects her dead sons from birds and animals. David hears about her care and arranges their burial.
rizpah.connections: Daughter of Aiah. Saul’s concubine. Mother of Armoni and one Mephibosheth.

rechab.name: Rechab
rechab.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
rechab.importance: David rejects the expected reward and orders his execution.
rechab.connections: Son of Rimmon. Brother of Baanah.

baanah.name: Baanah
baanah.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
baanah.importance: He participates in killing the sleeping king. He is distinct from other same-name figures.
baanah.connections: Son of Rimmon. Brother of Rechab.

mephibosheth-jonathan.name: Mephibosheth, Jonathan’s son
mephibosheth-jonathan.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
mephibosheth-jonathan.importance: David provides for Jonathan's son and spares him later. Mephibosheth also disputes Ziba's accusation.
mephibosheth-jonathan.connections: Son of Jonathan and grandson of Saul. Father of Mica.

mephibosheth-saul.name: Mephibosheth, Rizpah’s son
mephibosheth-saul.role: Son of Saul handed to the Gibeonites
mephibosheth-saul.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
mephibosheth-saul.importance: He dies among the seven. He is distinct from Jonathan’s son, who is spared.
mephibosheth-saul.connections: Son of Saul and Rizpah. Brother of Armoni.

armoni.name: Armoni
armoni.role: Son of Rizpah handed to the Gibeonites
armoni.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
armoni.importance: His death forms part of the account’s troubling response to famine.
armoni.connections: Son of Saul. Brother of Rizpah’s Mephibosheth.

uzzah.name: Uzzah
uzzah.role: Man who reaches toward the ark
uzzah.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
uzzah.importance: His death interrupts the procession. The text supplies limited personal background.

ahio.name: Ahio
ahio.role: Man who walks before the ark
ahio.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
ahio.importance: Ahio walks ahead of the cart that carries the ark.

obed-edom.name: Obed Edom
obed-edom.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
obed-edom.importance: His household receives blessings while the ark stays with him.
obed-edom.connections: Called a Gittite in this chapter.

nathan-prophet.name: Nathan
nathan-prophet.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
nathan-prophet.importance: He changes his initial advice after revelation. He uses a story to expose David’s wrongdoing.
nathan-prophet.connections: Counselor who announces the house promise and confronts David.

hiram.name: Hiram
hiram.role: King of Tyre who sends builders
hiram.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
hiram.importance: This chapter records royal cooperation without establishing an exact construction date.
hiram.connections: Provides cedar and craftsmen for David’s house.

hadadezer.name: Hadadezer
hadadezer.role: King of Zobah opposed by David
hadadezer.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
hadadezer.importance: His defeat belongs to the account’s presentation of David’s expanding rule.
hadadezer.connections: Son of Rehob. Associated with Aramean forces.

toi.name: Toi
toi.role: King of Hamath who sends congratulations
toi.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
toi.importance: He sends gifts after David defeats his opponent Hadadezer.
toi.connections: Father of Joram in this account.

joram-hamath.name: Joram
joram-hamath.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
joram-hamath.importance: He is distinct from later Israelite and Judean kings with the same name.

zadok.name: Zadok
zadok.role: Priest who supports David during the revolt
zadok.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
zadok.importance: He returns the ark to Jerusalem and helps transmit information.
zadok.connections: Son of Ahitub. Father of Ahimaaz.

benaiah.name: Benaiah
benaiah.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
benaiah.importance: Benaiah’s courage wins him a place over David’s guards. The chapter recalls his battles with lions and soldiers.

ziba.name: Ziba
ziba.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
ziba.importance: Ziba gains land after accusing Mephibosheth. Mephibosheth later disputes his account.
ziba.connections: Works under David’s grant to Mephibosheth.

machir.name: Machir
machir.role: Host who shelters Mephibosheth and helps David
machir.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
machir.importance: He houses Mephibosheth and later brings supplies to David’s company.

hanun.name: Hanun
hanun.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
hanun.importance: Suspicion leads him to reject David’s condolences and mistreat the messengers.

bathsheba.name: Bathsheba
bathsheba.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
bathsheba.importance: David sends for her. She reports pregnancy and mourns Uriah. The text does not report her consent.
bathsheba.connections: Daughter of Eliam. Wife of Uriah, later wife of David. Mother of Solomon.

uriah.name: Uriah
uriah.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
uriah.importance: His loyalty contrasts with the king’s deception. Joab carries out David’s order.
uriah.connections: Called a Hittite. Husband of Bathsheba.

unnamed-infant.name: Bathsheba’s unnamed infant
unnamed-infant.role: Child who dies after Nathan’s judgment
unnamed-infant.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
unnamed-infant.importance: The child becomes ill after Nathan confronts David. David fasts and prays before the child dies.
unnamed-infant.connections: Son of Bathsheba and David. Distinct from Solomon.

solomon.name: Solomon
solomon.role: Son born after the infant’s death
solomon.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
solomon.importance: This book reports his birth and naming. His later reign belongs to Kings.
solomon.connections: Son of Bathsheba and David. Nathan also calls him Jedidiah.

amnon.name: Amnon
amnon.role: David’s firstborn son who assaults Tamar
amnon.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
amnon.importance: He uses deception and force. Tamar’s protests make his responsibility clear.
amnon.connections: Son of Ahinoam. Half-brother of Tamar and Absalom.

absalom.name: Absalom
absalom.role: David’s son who leads a revolt
absalom.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
absalom.importance: He avenges Tamar, returns from exile, gathers support, and dies during the revolt.
absalom.connections: Son of Maacah. Tamar’s brother. Father of a daughter also named Tamar.

tamar-david.name: Tamar
tamar-david.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
tamar-david.importance: She protests Amnon's attack and cries out afterward. She then stays in Absalom's house.
tamar-david.connections: Daughter of David. Sister of Absalom and half-sister of Amnon.

jonadab.name: Jonadab
jonadab.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
jonadab.importance: He advises the scheme and later interprets the news of Amnon’s death.

tekoa-woman.name: The wise woman of Tekoa
tekoa-woman.role: Unnamed speaker who appeals to David
tekoa-woman.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
tekoa-woman.importance: She challenges the king’s judgment while participating in Joab’s plan.
tekoa-woman.connections: Joab instructs her constructed household story.

ittai.name: Ittai
ittai.role: Gittite commander who chooses to stay
ittai.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
ittai.importance: David offers him a chance to leave. Ittai instead promises to stay through danger.
ittai.connections: A foreigner and recent arrival with David.

hushai.name: Hushai
hushai.role: David’s friend and agent in Jerusalem
hushai.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
hushai.importance: His strategic advice buys time. Priests and messengers make it useful.
hushai.connections: Called an Archite. Opposes Ahithophel’s counsel.

ahithophel.name: Ahithophel
ahithophel.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
ahithophel.importance: His advice carries great weight. He dies by suicide after Absalom rejects his plan.

shimei-gera.name: Shimei
shimei-gera.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
shimei-gera.importance: David restrains retaliation during flight and grants him an oath on return.

ahimaaz.name: Ahimaaz
ahimaaz.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
ahimaaz.importance: He escapes detection and later runs to David with news.
ahimaaz.connections: Son of Zadok. Works with Jonathan son of Abiathar.

jonathan-abiathar.name: Jonathan, Abiathar’s son
jonathan-abiathar.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
jonathan-abiathar.importance: He is distinct from Saul’s son and David’s nephew.
jonathan-abiathar.connections: Son of Abiathar. Companion of Ahimaaz.

en-rogel-servant.name: The servant woman at En Rogel
en-rogel-servant.role: Unnamed messenger in the information network
en-rogel-servant.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
en-rogel-servant.importance: Her work carries information beyond the council room. No name is supplied.

bahurim-woman.name: The woman at Bahurim
bahurim-woman.role: Unnamed woman who protects the messengers
bahurim-woman.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
bahurim-woman.importance: Her practical action helps David’s company escape. She is distinct from the servant at En Rogel.
bahurim-woman.connections: Conceals the courtyard well and misdirects pursuers.

amasa.name: Amasa
amasa.role: Commander appointed by Absalom and then David
amasa.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
amasa.importance: David offers him Joab’s command. Joab later kills him.
amasa.connections: Son of Ithra and Abigail, sister of Zeruiah.

abigail-sister.name: Abigail, David’s sister
abigail-sister.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
abigail-sister.importance: This Abigail is Amasa’s mother. She differs from the Abigail who marries David.
abigail-sister.connections: Sister of Zeruiah. The chapter calls her a daughter of Nahash.

shobi.name: Shobi
shobi.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
shobi.importance: He brings supplies with Machir and Barzillai. His aid contrasts with earlier hostility involving Ammon.

barzillai.name: Barzillai
barzillai.role: Older Gileadite who supplies David’s company
barzillai.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
barzillai.importance: He declines court support and chooses to return home. He is distinct from Adriel’s Meholathite father.
barzillai.connections: From Rogelim. Sends Chimham with David.

cushite-messenger.name: The Cushite messenger
cushite-messenger.role: Unnamed runner who reports Absalom’s death
cushite-messenger.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
cushite-messenger.importance: He runs to tell David about the victory and Absalom's death.
cushite-messenger.connections: Sent by Joab after the battle.

word.languageNote: This is the dictionary form of the name “Cushite.”

chimham.name: Chimham
chimham.role: Companion sent with the returning king
chimham.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
chimham.importance: The chapter promises care without describing his later life.

sheba-bichri.name: Sheba
sheba-bichri.role: Leader of a revolt after David’s return
sheba-bichri.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
sheba-bichri.importance: He takes refuge at Abel and dies during the negotiated end of the siege.

abel-woman.name: The wise woman of Abel
abel-woman.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
abel-woman.importance: She argues against destroying the town and negotiates a resolution that includes Sheba’s death.
abel-woman.connections: Speaks for the threatened city of Abel Beth Maacah.

royal-concubines.name: David’s ten concubines
royal-concubines.role: Women targeted during the struggle for kingship
royal-concubines.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
royal-concubines.importance: Absalom publicly violates them. David later confines and provides for them. The text gives no names or account of their consent.
royal-concubines.connections: Left in Jerusalem when David flees.

sibbecai.name: Sibbecai
sibbecai.role: Warrior in a recalled Philistine battle
sibbecai.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
sibbecai.importance: Sibbecai kills the Philistine warrior Saph at Gob.

elhanan-jaare.name: Elhanan
elhanan-jaare.role: Warrior associated with the disputed Goliath reading
elhanan-jaare.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
elhanan-jaare.importance: The Hebrew text names Goliath as his victim. This reading text adds brother, following a harmonizing interpretation.

jonathan-shimei.name: Jonathan, David’s nephew
jonathan-shimei.role: Warrior who defeats a large Philistine
jonathan-shimei.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
jonathan-shimei.importance: He is distinct from Jonathan son of Saul and Jonathan son of Abiathar.

josheb-basshebeth.name: Josheb Basshebeth
josheb-basshebeth.role: Warrior at the head of the list
josheb-basshebeth.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
josheb-basshebeth.importance: The warrior list credits him with killing eight hundred men in one battle.
josheb-basshebeth.connections: Called a Tahchemonite and Adino the Eznite in the reading text.

eleazar-dodai.name: Eleazar
eleazar-dodai.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
eleazar-dodai.importance: He is distinct from the ark keeper and Aaron’s son.
eleazar-dodai.connections: Son of Dodai, associated with an Ahohite.

shammah-agee.name: Shammah
shammah-agee.role: Warrior who defends a lentil field
shammah-agee.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
shammah-agee.importance: He is distinct from David’s brother. The chapter recalls his refusal to abandon the field.

araunah.name: Araunah
araunah.role: Jebusite owner of the threshing floor
araunah.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
araunah.importance: He offers his ground for an altar. David insists on paying for the land and animals.
araunah.connections: Offers the site, cattle, and wood to David.

abinadab-ark.name: Abinadab
abinadab-ark.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
abinadab-ark.importance: His hilltop house receives the ark. He is distinct from David’s brother and Saul’s son.
abinadab-ark.connections: Father of Eleazar, the appointed ark keeper.

saul.name: Saul
saul.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
saul.importance: Saul’s death divides Israel’s leadership. David mourns him instead of celebrating the loss of a rival.
saul.connections: Son of Kish. Father of Jonathan, Merab, Michal, and other children.

nahash.name: Nahash
nahash.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
nahash.importance: David sends messengers to comfort Nahash’s son Hanun after Nahash dies.
nahash.connections: Opponent of Saul’s rescue of Jabesh Gilead.

jonathan-saul.name: Jonathan
jonathan-saul.role: Saul’s son, warrior, and David’s covenant friend
jonathan-saul.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
jonathan-saul.importance: David remembers Jonathan’s friendship. He later cares for Jonathan’s son Mephibosheth.
jonathan-saul.connections: Brother of Merab and Michal. Son of Saul.

abner.name: Abner
abner.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
abner.importance: He establishes Ishbosheth’s rule, then negotiates with David. Joab kills him after Asahel’s death.
abner.connections: Son of Ner. Connected with Saul’s family.

merab.name: Merab
merab.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
merab.importance: Merab’s sons appear in the account of Saul’s family. Some old copies name Michal instead.
merab.connections: Offered to David but married to Adriel.

michal.name: Michal
michal.role: Saul’s daughter who helps David escape
michal.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
michal.importance: She returns to David through negotiations. Later, she challenges how he behaves before the ark.
michal.connections: Wife of David, later given by Saul to Palti.

goliath.name: Goliath
goliath.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
goliath.importance: His challenge leaves Israel's soldiers afraid. David faces him with a sling.
goliath.connections: Opponent of David in the duel account.

adriel.name: Adriel
adriel.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
adriel.importance: He receives the marriage first offered to David. The book provides no extended personal account.

gad.name: Gad
gad.role: Prophet who advises David during flight
gad.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
gad.importance: He announces the choices after the census and instructs David to build an altar.
gad.connections: Directs David away from the stronghold toward Judah.

abiathar.name: Abiathar
abiathar.role: Priest who escapes the Nob massacre
abiathar.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
abiathar.importance: He survives violence against his household and helps David seek direction.
abiathar.connections: Son of Ahimelech. Joins David with an ephod.

abigail.name: Abigail
abigail.role: Woman who prevents David’s retaliatory attack
abigail.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
abigail.importance: David’s wife accompanies his move to Hebron. She is distinct from Amasa’s mother.

ahinoam-david.name: Ahinoam
ahinoam-david.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
ahinoam-david.importance: She is distinct from Saul’s wife. Her presence makes household vulnerability part of David’s flight.
ahinoam-david.connections: Captured at Ziklag with Abigail, then recovered.

palti.name: Palti
palti.role: Man to whom Saul gives Michal
palti.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
palti.importance: Also called Paltiel. He follows Michal weeping until Abner sends him home.

abishai.name: Abishai
abishai.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
abishai.importance: He commands forces, proposes retaliation against Shimei, and rescues David during battle.
abishai.connections: Son of Zeruiah and brother of Joab.

jesse.name: Jesse
jesse.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
jesse.importance: He presents sons to Samuel and sends provisions to the battlefront. David later seeks safety for his parents.
jesse.connections: Father of Eliab, Abinadab, Shammah, David, and other sons.

david.name: David
david.role: King whose rule includes achievement and destructive wrongdoing
david.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
david.importance: David makes Jerusalem his capital and helps Jonathan’s son. His abuse of power also harms Uriah and his own family.
david.connections: Son of Jesse. Father of Amnon, Absalom, Tamar, Solomon, and other children.

abimelech.name: Abimelech
abimelech.life: Historical birth and death years are not securely known.
abimelech.importance: His rise and fall show destructive ambition and retaliation. He is distinct from Genesis’s Abimelech.
abimelech.connections: His mother is from Shechem. Jotham survives his attack on his brothers.

thembez-woman.name: The woman at Thebez
thembez-woman.role: Unnamed defender recalled in Joab’s message
thembez-woman.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
thembez-woman.importance: Joab recalls her action as a warning about approaching a defended wall.
thembez-woman.connections: Drops a millstone on Abimelech in Judges 9.
